$comment: Validation classes + determinant-to-instrument map (v2 design, section 5). Each class's DEFINING determinants map to exactly one instrument: a vocabulary tag id (detection threshold: present in >= 2/3 of the class's exemplars) or a measured scalar (predicted raw-scale range). Defining determinants with no instrument are excluded ex ante as named blind spots and the per-class denominator is recomputed. This file is the naming vocabulary source and the validation spec; it is scaffolding for grounding and validation, never a dictionary a board must fit. FROZEN at the freeze commit.
namedBlindSpots: true-grid-geometry: strict-column-grid and asymmetric-composition are checked by vision tag, not geometric extraction; measuring actual column alignment is v3+ if vision tags prove insufficient

pattern-adjacency-geometry: accentHueCount counts hue families but cannot verify that clashing colors sit ADJACENT with no mediation; adjacency is carried by the pattern-clash-adjacency vision tag where applicable
spacing-module-rhythm: repeated-spacing-module (ITS common) has no instrument; common-strength only, so no denominator impact

its.label: International Typographic Style
its.notes: Board-owner cross-check (2026-07-11): layout is primary, color secondary. The defining list is all structure, typography, and imagery; palette enters only at common strength (restricted-palette-single-accent, predicted accentHueCount 0-2). A strict grid in other colors still reads as this style; a loose grid in black-and-white does not.

brutalism-minimal.label: Web brutalism, minimalist raw-HTML strand
brutalism-minimal.notes: Strand-level defining list per the v2 design: the two umbrella determinants plus browser-default-styling and dense-utilitarian-lists promoted (Craigslist/Copeland lineage).

brutalism-maximal.label: Web brutalism, maximalist anti-design strand

defining.blindSpotNote: adjacency without mediation is not verified, only hue-family count

brutalism-maximal.notes: Strand-level defining list per the v2 design: umbrella plus harsh-unharmonized-color-clash, oversized-load-bearing-type, deliberate-misalignment-or-overlap promoted (Deville catalog lineage).

defining.blindSpotNote: the scatter half is corroborated by scattered-geometric-primitives; the instrument checks the asymmetry half
